name: Aider Polyglot
intro: Aider Polyglot 从6种语言的697道Exercism练习中，经7个模型全量预试，选出仅被不超过3个模型解出的225道难题，用端到端代码编辑和单元测试衡量模型表现。
build_method: Exercism题库筛选, 多模型难度预试, Docker单元测试
metric: 任务完成率, 正确编辑格式率
task_type: 代码编辑, 代码生成
eval_feature: 多语言代码编辑, 端到端补丁应用, 单元测试
build_method_en: Exercism task filtering, seven-model difficulty probing, Docker unit tests
eval_feature_en: Multilingual code editing, end-to-end patch application, unit tests
intro_en: Aider Polyglot starts from 697 Exercism exercises in six languages, probes all of them with seven models, selects the 225 tasks solved by no more than three models, and evaluates end-to-end code editing with unit tests.

    G --> H(Aider Polyglot Dataset\n225 Exercises: C++, Go, Java, JS, Python, Rust)
    H --> I[Evaluate LLM Code Editing Ability]
    I --> J[Benchmark Results]

drawio_review_note: Aligned with the official Aider Polyglot announcement and Aider benchmark harness rather than a standalone paper. The sources describe 697 Exercism tasks across C++, Go, Java, JavaScript, Python, and Rust, a seven-model difficulty probe, selection of the 225 tasks solved by at most three models, and end-to-end edit application plus unit-test scoring in Docker.
